source.source_title: iPod nano (6th generation) - Technical Specifications - Apple Support (IE)
source.verification_notes: Official Apple technical-specification page captured as original HTML on 2026-11-11; 13 source sections extracted. The first record section preserves model-identification evidence from Apple's separate identification page.
notes: Technical specifications in the following sections are transcribed from the model-specific Apple technical-specification page; each section carries its own source URL and archive path.

The first section preserves model number/introduction-date evidence from Apple's separate identification page: https://support.apple.com/en-ie/103823, archived at apple_remaining_extraction/technical_specs_html/ipod-index.html.

extraction.note: Official Apple iPod identification text retained. Explicit model numbers, introduction dates, capacity options and navigation interface extracted where present with source-section provenance. These are identification-page records, not full historical technical-specification sheets; no absent specs inferred.

sections.heading: iPod nano (6th generation)
sections.source_text:
Navigation: Multi-Touch display
Capacity: 8 and 16 GB
Model number and date introduced: A1366: September 2010
iPod nano (6th generation) is available in six colours.
iPod nano (PRODUCT) RED Special Edition is available only from the Apple Store, with an 8 GB or 16 GB capacity. Apple contributes a portion of each iPod nano (PRODUCT) RED Special Edition purchase to the Global Fund to fight HIV/AIDS in Africa.

sections.heading: Size and Weight
sections.source_text: Height: 1.48 inches (37.5 mm)    Width: 1.61 inches (40.9 mm)    Depth: 0.35 inch (8.78 mm) including clip    Weight: 0.74 ounce (21.1 grams) 1     Volume: 0.614 cu. inch (10,056 cu. mm)

sections.heading: Display
sections.source_text: 1.54-inch (diagonal) color TFT display    240-by-240-pixel resolution    220 pixels per inch

sections.heading: Audio Playback
sections.source_text: Frequency response: 20Hz to 20,000Hz    Audio formats supported: AAC (8 to 320 Kbps), Protected AAC (from iTunes Store), HE-AAC, MP3 (8 to 320 Kbps), MP3 VBR, Audible (formats 2, 3, 4, Audible Enhanced Audio, AAX, and AAX+), Apple Lossless, AIFF, and WAV    User-configurable maximum volume limit

sections.heading: FM Radio
sections.source_text: Regional settings for Americas, Asia, Australia, Europe, and Japan    Live Pause feature for pausing a radio broadcast and rewinding (within a 15-minute buffer)

sections.heading: Battery and Power   3
sections.source_text: Built-in rechargeable lithium-ion battery    Up to 24 hours of music playback when fully charged    Charging via USB to computer system or power adapter (sold separately)    Fast-charge time: about 1.5 hours (charges up to 80% of battery capacity)    Full-charge time: about 3 hours

sections.heading: Languages
sections.source_text: 29 UI languages: Arabic, Brazilian Portuguese, Cantonese (Traditional Chinese), Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, English, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hebrew, Hungarian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Slovak, Spanish, Swedish, Thai, Traditional Chinese, Turkish    Song, album, and artist information can also be displayed in Bulgarian, Serbian, Slovenian, Ukrainian, and Vietnamese. For Arabic and Hebrew language support, some UI elements are not right to left.    Fitness spoken feedback is available in seven languages: Chinese (Mandarin), English (U.S.), French (France), German, Italian, Japanese, Spanish (Spain).    29 VoiceOver languages: Chinese (Cantonese, Mandarin), Czech, Danish, Dutch, English (Australia, UK, and U.S.), Finnish, French (Canada, France), German, Greek, Hungarian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil, Portugal), Romanian, Russian, Slovak, Spanish (Mexico, Spain), Swedish, Thai, Turkish

sections.heading: In the Box
sections.source_text: iPod nano    Apple Earphones    Dock Connector to USB Cable    Quick Start guide and Important Product Information

sections.heading: Headphones
sections.source_text: Earphones    Frequency response: 20Hz to 20,000Hz    Impedance: 32 ohms

sections.heading: Accessibility
sections.source_text: VoiceOver gesture-based screen reader    High-resolution LCD display with adjustable backlight settings for easier reading in low light    White on black display    Mono Audio

sections.heading: System Requirements
sections.source_text: Mac computer with USB 2.0 port, OS X v10.5.8 or later, and iTunes 10 or later 4     PC with USB 2.0 port; Windows 7, Vista, or XP Home or Professional (SP3) or later; and iTunes 10 or later    Internet access required; broadband recommended; fees may apply

sections.heading: Environmental Requirements
sections.source_text: Operating temperature: 32° to 95° F (0° to 35° C)    Nonoperating temperature: -4° to 113° F (-20° to 45° C)    Relative humidity: 5% to 95% noncondensing    Maximum operating altitude: 10,000 feet (3000 m)
